item.title: Review: 2026 Kia Carnival 1.6 SX+ Turbo Hybrid
item.description: I hate the Kia Carnival. I hate it because each time I drive it to pick friends up, they all end up competing over the second row seats making me feel like a chauffeur 99.9 percent of the time. I don’t blame them, I guess. In a world increasingly filled with towering SUVs and crossovers, the Carnival’s sliding doors and low step-in height make for a surprisingly easy, practical, and well-packaged family or, for those in the C-suite, luxury conveyance.Read More »

item.title: VinFast Leads BEV Aftersales Confidence With Laguna Parts And Distribution Center
item.description: VinFast Philippines today announced that its local parts and distribution center now houses more than 80,000 vehicle parts since its market entry in 2024. Its 3,975 square-meter warehouse at DHL Parts Distribution Center in Santa Rosa, Laguna boosts local user confidence in VinFast battery electric vehicles, underscoring the brand’s robust logistics and warehousing ecosystem, ready to support and elevate after-sales services for its distributors and partners nationwide.Read More »
